mods.name: RaveCraft
mods.description: Functional, realistic sound, DJ and lighting gear: from a portable speaker to a festival soundsystem.

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Add audio core spec and portable speaker plan by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/1
* Add portable speaker by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/2
* Stop tracking the datagen hash cache by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/4
* Add local music playback by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/3
* Relay speaker audio to nearby players by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/5
* Add shared speaker queue by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/6
* Let the portable speaker sit in water by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/8
* Render speakers through a realistic acoustic engine by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/7
* Muffle speakers through blocks and media by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/9
* Add room reverb, echoes and underwater sound colour by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/10
* Add an in-world acoustic debug view by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/12
* Add the full speaker player and music library by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/11
* Measure echoes from the wall's mirror image by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/14
* Remove the reverberant tail in open spaces by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/13
* Add queue reordering by drag and drop by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/15
* Add speaker now-playing notifications by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/16
* Add track info tooltips and Artist — Title display by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/17
* Meet the code rules across the codebase by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/19
* Keep portable speakers playing when carried by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/18
* Add the party speaker by @justinmiteran in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/20

## New Contributors
* @justinmiteran made their first contribution in https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justinmiteran/RaveCraft/commits/v0.1.0

readmeSummary: Mod Fabric pour Minecraft 26.3 : du matériel de sonorisation, de DJ et d'éclairage fonctionnel et réaliste (enceintes, platines, tables de mixage, projecteurs, consoles lumière…).
